messages:
Sam K: Quick heads-up — planning a rollout for flag `fastpath_v2` tonight 01:00 UTC. Target 10% for the first hour, then 50% if metrics look good. Need an owner for the flip + someone to run smoke and be ready to rollback.
Elaine P: I can own the flip and smoke. Will be on-call tonight. What are the concrete smoke checks you want?
Sam K: Thanks! Key checks: 1) API /health returns 200, 2) p50 token-gen latency < 80ms, 3) error rate < 0.5% across routes. Also watch for memory OOMs on replica hosts.
Ajay R: Where's the toggle in the console? Is this the same key we used in staging?
Sam K: Yes same key: `flag:fastpath_v2`. Console path: Console > Feature Flags > fastpath_v2. Deploy CLI: `redwood flags set fastpath_v2 --pct 10 --env prod` (only infra has CLI access tonight).
Kevin L: Kill switch details? If we see an issue, what's the fastest rollback?
Sam K: Rollback options: 1) CLI quick set to 0% (fastest), 2) Console flip to safe default (false), 3) Route traffic to fallback model pool (manual, slower). Elaine, please be ready to execute `redwood flags set fastpath_v2 --pct 0` if anything crosses thresholds.
Elaine P: Got it. I'll run synthetic smoke runs from eu-west-1 and us-east-1 immediately after flip. I'll use the small stress harness: 
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate; sleep 0.2; done
```
Elaine P: I'll aggregate results in #eng-platform with a short summary: p50/p95 latency, 5xx count, mem usage snapshots.
Ajay R: Quick question — what are the safe defaults if something goes wrong? Do we prefer degrade to `fastpath_v1` or full disable?
Sam K: Preference is to revert to default=false for the flag (i.e., disable v2). That routes traffic back to fastpath_v1. Only if disabling creates a regression we consider targeted routing to v1 pool.
Kevin L: I'll watch infra metrics and have a fast link to fallback in case of backend saturation. Also adding an alert: `alert_fastpath_errors` with threshold 1% over 5m and `alert_latency_p50` > 120ms.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: feature-flip job queued by @Sam K for 2023-11-03T01:00:00Z (job id j-8a7f). Notification will post to this thread when the job starts/ends.
Elaine P: Confirming timeline: 00:55 UTC — final preflight checks, 01:00 UTC — flip to 10%, 01:10 UTC — initial smoke summary, 02:00 UTC — decision point to ramp to 50% or rollback.
Sam K: That's the plan. If all good, we can finish ramp to 100% tomorrow morning after business hours.
Ajay R: I'll watch A/B quality metrics and surface any divergence. If >2% drop in quality, I will request rollback.
Elaine P: If I see >0.5% errors or p50 > 80ms consistently across both regions I'll flip to 0% and ping infra.
Kevin L: :thumbsup: I'll keep a console session open and be ready to revoke rollout if alerts fire.
Sam K: Thanks team — I'll add a short runbook to the #eng-platform pins and update the deploy doc with the CLI command. Elaine, ping here when you start preflight.
Elaine P: Will do.
Sam K: Closing loop: owner=Elaine P, infra standby=Kevin L, metrics/QA=Ajay R, rollback command=`redwood flags set fastpath_v2 --pct 0`.
Elaine P: Starting preflight at 00:55 UTC. See you in the thread. :rocket:
